title: Essence of the Transmission
subtitle: Test your grasp of Essence of the Transmission — CUBE containment, Second Realm crystal, scare sequence, and the return to solar-creator resonance.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: Not a globe. A CUBE. Crystalline electro-magnetic hard drive. Eight domes. One hundred seventy-eight interwoven worlds. Sound sang Light into crystalline plasma — brick and concrete are low-frequency overlays. Fallen Custodians farmed the KNOWN LANDS with Anunnaki, Draconians, Greys, and Niburians. Spirit Tree out; Saturn black cube valves in. Sun is a stargate with a Vatican-linked amnesia vortex. Real Motherships call by Sol lock; Blue Beam is theater. NPCs dissolve. Hold frequency. Starve fear. When the false sky falls, we do not build back — we reveal back. You are the resonance. The path home is open.

relatedTopic.label: Return to Essence of the Transmission deep-dive

questions.question: What is the direct lived reality of our physical plane in this transmission?

options.label: A
options.text: A massive crystalline, electro-magnetic framework inside a vast CUBE containment, not a floating globe in an empty vacuum.
options.rationale: The plane is crystalline EM architecture inside CUBE containment, not a globe in vacuum.

options.label: B
options.text: A flat plain beneath a single dome, lit by a local sun, with no larger containment structure around it and no crystalline framework below the ground.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. The plane is crystalline EM architecture inside CUBE containment, not a globe in vacuum.

options.label: C
options.text: A shared dream held together by belief, which would fade if enough people stopped believing in it.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. The plane is crystalline EM architecture inside CUBE containment, not a globe in vacuum.

options.label: D
options.text: A spinning ball of rock in an empty vacuum, as taught in the schools, but far older than claimed.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. The plane is crystalline EM architecture inside CUBE containment, not a globe in vacuum.

questions.hint: Crystalline EM framework in CUBE containment — not a floating globe.
